normalization: Original Step59 train-fitted vocabulary, explicit UNSEEN bins and saved MLP scaler; no fit on shift
aggregation: Numeric and one-hot columns: mean,std(ddof0),min,max,last; identical operations for both representations
validation_replay: 16 evenly spaced validation endpoints per true class; audit only, no model selection

bootstrap.unit: whole common nominal episode including all six class replicas
bootstrap.pairing: same multiplicities across four regimes, representations, learners and fixed seeds
bootstrap.estimator: mean of per-seed endpoint Macro-F1/FPR/recall; no probability ensemble or pooled-seed confusion
bootstrap.intervals: conditional linear-percentile95; Bonferroni16 within each of three pair families (matched_scope: Semantic22-RawScoped, scope_effect: RawScoped-Raw, all_link: Semantic22-Raw) over 4 conditions x2 learners x2 metrics; change families Bonferroni12

scope_policy: Per-window single-path observation contract of the pinned mapper: the six channels of the four links (snr/sinr, frame_loss_rate, crc_error_count, decode_fail_count, retry_count, timeout_count) are kept only for the link selected by raw_path_type (GATEWAY_LEO->ttc, LEO_LEO->isl, IOT_LEO->iot, UAV_LEO->uav); channels of non-selected links are set to 0 and four link_observed_* indicators are added (all 0 for GNSS_LEO and INTERNAL_ONBOARD). GNSS monitors, command/session/transition flags, counts and the eleven context categories are common to every window and unchanged. This matches the information the 22-field projection can read, not a physical claim that other links are unobservable.
interpretation: Retrospective analysis using previously observed source regimes; not preregistered confirmation.
Same generator with joint parameter changes; no external validity or isolated factor-causality claim.
Raw simulated measurements and monitor outputs; not raw RF waveforms.
Deterministic projection does not create information; differences are learner/feature interactions.
Raw and semantic temporal statistics do not preserve every ordering detail.
Report absolute scores and NORMAL false alarms as well as changes; smaller loss alone is not superiority.
All endpoints including quiet/unchanged inputs retained; no label, provenance, baseline or cause fields enter model.
Intervals conditional on these trained models and one paired nominal realization; not formal equivalence.
